alerts.title: Overdue serum creatinine monitoring on TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring for patients on TDF-based regimens. The patient's only creatinine result is from 2024-10-01, 478 days before this visit — over 15 months old. No renal function tests have been ordered today. TDF can cause chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, and Fanconi syndrome. While the patient appears well with no new complaints, the absence of recent renal monitoring represents a significant gap given TDF's known nephrotoxicity profile.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR to assess renal function, given TDF nephrotoxicity risk and 15-month gap since last testing.

alerts.title: Viral load borderline at threshold, monitoring due
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend routine viral load monitoring at 6 months after ART initiation, then every 12 months for adults. The patient's last viral load was 40 copies/mL on 2025-10-01, 113 days before this visit. This value is suppressed (≤200 copies/mL) but approaching the threshold. The next scheduled VL is due around April 2026. No VL was ordered today, which is acceptable if the annual schedule is on track, but the clinician should confirm timing.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm next viral load is scheduled approximately 12 months after the last test (around October 2026) per adult monitoring guidelines.
